stories.headline: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
stories.body: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are looking to expand the use of AI agents in financial transactions.

stories.headline: Fed’s Guynn: reform ‘increased the intensity of supervision’
stories.body: Randall Guynn, head of the Federal Reserve’s supervision and regulation division, said the central bank’s supervision is more concentrated and effective, saying it has “increased the intensity of supervision on things that matter.”
